P2/P3 are the previous attempt's heart and asthma questions with the inception age moved back so the rule reaches them; their pinned facts are the previous attempt's real extractions with that one number edited, and P3's stated '60 years known' removed so the code guard cannot rescue it (the hostile case: the extraction is unstable on this sentence).
